https://anthropic.com/research/ai-expect.title: The AI expectations gap
https://anthropic.com/research/ai-expect.summary: How will AI reshape the economy in the years ahead? What is the core source of disagreement about AI's future impact on the economy? This note presents new survey evidence on these questions.

https://anthropic.com/news/an-update-on-.title: Anthropic update on independent evaluators
https://anthropic.com/news/an-update-on-.summary: Anthropic announces updates to embedding independent evaluators

https://anthropic.com/news/public-benefi.title: Investing in the public benefit
https://anthropic.com/news/public-benefi.summary: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

https://anthropic.com/research/expectati.title: Working at the frontier shapes expectations for the future
https://anthropic.com/research/expectati.summary: We’re sharing two reports: the first covers how AI is changing employment inside Anthropic, and the second looks at the gap between how the public and Anthropic employees expect AI to affect work and the economy.

https://anthropic.com/research/employmen.title: How employment is changing at Anthropic
https://anthropic.com/research/employmen.summary: How has AI restructured work and employment at Anthropic? As a company at the frontier of AI adoption, Anthropic could be a leading indicator of how AI will shift work organization, hiring, and labor demand across the economy.

https://anthropic.com/research/ecdsa-cur.title: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
https://anthropic.com/research/ecdsa-cur.summary: The decades-old mystery of the origins of one of the most popular cryptographic standards has been explained.

https://anthropic.com/research/designing.title: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
https://anthropic.com/research/designing.summary: Working largely on its own, Claude designed quantum circuits that improve on the best published versions, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more.

https://anthropic.com/news/2026-us-midte.title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
https://anthropic.com/news/2026-us-midte.summary: Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards. Here, we outline how we’ve continued to strengthen these safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.

https://anthropic.com/news/singapore-off.title: Singapore office and government MOU | Anthropic
https://anthropic.com/news/singapore-off.summary: Anthropic opens its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signs an MOU with the government on AI safety, evaluation, and responsible adoption.

https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/data-m.title: Research from the Team Behind CausalMix Offers A Technique to Select Fine-Tuning Examples
https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/data-m.summary: When you’re building a fine-tuning dataset, finding a mix of subject domains that yields a high-performing model can require expensive trial...

https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/comput.title: Apple’s Mac mini and Mac Studio Have Competition From Microsoft and Nvidia
https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/comput.summary: Developers have warmed to the economics and security of local models, either as an alternative or a complement to the cloud.

https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/mistra.title: Mistral Large 4, the Leading European AI Model, Outperforms All Open Models Outside of China
https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/mistra.summary: Mistral’s latest model is its largest and most capable, and the most powerful yet released by a European company.

https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/claude.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 Give Developers Fast, Highly Capable Alternatives to Opus 5.5
https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/claude.summary: Claude Haiku, Anthropic’s fastest and least expensive model gets a long-awaited update.

https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/formal.title: Formal Verification Meets Unverifiable Judgement: Don’t Overgeneralize from Progress in Math and Code — The Hardest AI Problems Still Require More Work
https://deeplearning.ai/the-batch/formal.summary: The gulf between LLM performance on verifiable tasks vs. unverifiable tasks that require judgement is larger than most people realize.
